note: Weights only. No scenario text, no scene script, no if-this-town-then-that. The engine reads these when it chooses and arranges pieces (src/english/calibration.ts); scripts/dialogue-batch/apply-grades.ts folds the owner's grades in. An empty table changes nothing.

step.checkedAgainst: How far one grade of 1 to 5 moves a weight; small so no single grade decides a piece.

pieceFloor.checkedAgainst: The lowest share of its weight a piece with a running grade of 1 keeps (it is chosen less, never banned; a ban is a failed grade in part-grades.json).

pieceCeiling.checkedAgainst: The highest multiple a piece with a running grade of 5 can reach.

pieceFullAt.checkedAgainst: Grades at which a piece's running mean counts in full; fewer count in proportion.

lengthSlope.checkedAgainst: How fast a piece loses weight as it departs from the register's target length, per fraction of the target.

pullScale.checkedAgainst: How many words of target length one unit of a trait's length pull moves, as a share of the target.
